name: contract-example-dialog
goal: Read typed contract inputs and outputs as compact tables; open honest examples in an accessible shared modal.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Inputs and outputs use compact semantic tables with names, descriptions and data types. An info icon opens examples in the existing modal; source files stay hidden.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standard entity contract checks require inline samples and omit dialog interaction. Extend those same component and responsive browser checks for tables, labelled examples, Escape, focus return and mobile fit.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Final sealed red c2219832 at b474b54d fails the missing-table assertion at all three widths. Earlier checkpoint a725a055 is retained; corrected assertions use DOM labels and the shared modal Close name.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 implemented typed tables, shared-modal examples and one-field lazy mounting. Focused unit and responsive browser cases pass; web build, types and lint pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Red c2219832 at b474b54d and green abc0e99a at 719238c7 use the same 1,257 inputs, command and environment. The responsive table/modal cases and unit checks pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: 569 web unit, 62 preview and 11 integration/evidence checks pass, with 144 required screenshots. Live desktop/mobile images inspected. Root format/types/lint/Rust and 847 unit tests pass; aggregate run stopped before paused Electron checks. Three existing web file-size findings block full verification. RAM peak 7.1 GB.
